title: Palindrome Partitioning
kidExplanation: Story version: To partition a given string into palindromic substrings, we can use backtracking. Starting from each position in the string, we check if the substring from that position to the end is a palindrome. If it is, we recursively partition the remaining substring and continue the process. We keep track of the current partition in a list and store valid partitions in the result. (We will slow down and draw it.)
